channel.title: Tidy Home Routines
channel.description: Simple cleaning and organizing routines that stick.

item.title: How Often to Clean the Dryer Lint Trap and Vent
item.description: U.S. Fire Administration data on clothes dryer fires and a simple lint and vent cleaning routine, from every load to a seasonal vent check.

item.title: How to Clean vs Disinfect, a Weekly Routine That Works
item.description: A weekly cleaning routine built on CDC's official distinction between cleaning and disinfecting, so each surface gets the right level of treatment.

item.title: How to Read Laundry Care Symbols, and Why They're a Federal Rule
item.description: What the FTC's Care Labeling Rule actually requires on clothing tags, and how to read the care symbols it allows manufacturers to use instead of words.

item.title: Preventing Mold, the Humidity Number Your Weekly Routine Should Track
item.description: EPA's official indoor humidity targets for mold prevention, and the specific weekly checks that act on that number instead of just reacting to visible mold.

item.title: Safe Cleaning Product Combinations to Avoid
item.description: CDC and EPA guidance on which common household cleaners should never be mixed, and the safety steps to take when disinfecting with bleach.
